
## Options

```
      --app string    filter to the records whose data.app is this MCP server
      --limit int     max records the server returns, before the server filter (default 50)
      --type string   filter to one CloudEvent type, for example straza.audit.mcp
      --user string   filter to one user (id or username)
```
